abilities.name: Raven Form
abilities.description: Instead of mounting, Medivh can transform into a raven, increasing Movement Speed by 20%. While transformed, Medivh can see and fly over all terrain and is immune to all effects.

fields.props: Immune to damage, Movement Speed, Untargetable
fields.notes: Medivh has reduced sight radius during Raven Form . Medivh cannot be targeted by allied or enemy effects while Mounted, but any effects applied beforehand persist for their duration. Using Abilities causes Medivh to leave Raven Form. Medivh cannot leave Raven Form, and thus also cannot use Abilities, while above unpathable terrain. Medivh can pick up and receive Regeneration Globes and use Healing Fountain in Raven Form . Medivh can collect Experience Globes while in Raven Form . Raven Form removes Medivh from the ground plane, disjointing certain projectiles.

abilities.name: Arcane Rift
abilities.description: Launch a rift that deals 170 damage to enemies in its path. If an enemy Hero is hit, reduce its cooldown by 5 seconds and refund 50 Mana. quest Hit 40 enemy Heroes with Arcane Rift without dying. Permanently increases the damage dealt by 75 and cooldown reduction for hitting a Hero by 1 second.

abilities.name: Force of Will
abilities.description: Protect an allied Hero from all damage for 1.5 seconds. Upon expiration, Force of Will heals the target 20% of the damage it absorbed.

fields.notes: Healing is calculated from the final damage taken, after all damage modifiers.

abilities.name: Portal
abilities.description: Create a set of portals between you and the target location, allowing allies to teleport between both. The portals last 6 seconds.

fields.notes: Allied Heroes have to perform a 0.25 second Waygate Channel to enter the Portal. The channel is interrupted if the target is Stunned, Rooted, Dazed, put in Stasis or killed. Active Portals grant vision in 3.0 radius. If a Hero dies from Area of Effect damage during the Waygate Channel, but it is not otherwise interrupted, the Channel will still complete, which is relevant for Heroes with Special Death States (e.g. Leoric, Uther, Tyrael, Gall if taking Psychotic Break).

abilities.name: Poly Bomb
abilities.description: Polymorph an enemy Hero for 2 seconds, Silencing them and making them unable to attack. On expiration, Poly Bomb spreads to other nearby enemy Heroes.; 40; 75; Heroic

fields.notes: Poly Bomb can spread to the same target multiple times, but it cannot spread to enemies that were already carrying it. Polymorph counts as a Silence effect. Effects that interact with Silences also interact with Poly Bomb .

abilities.name: Ley Line Seal
abilities.description: After 0.5 seconds, unleash a wave of energy that places enemy Heroes in Time Stop for 3 seconds.; 80; 75; Heroic

fields.props: Area of Effect, Channeled cast (stationary), Time Stop
fields.notes: Interrupting the Ability during its windup puts it on a 10 second cooldown.

talents.name: Portal Mastery
talents.description: ActiveMedivh can manually place both Portal locations and it no longer breaks Raven Form. yellowtext Activate Medivh's Trait to cancel an unliked Portal.

fields.notes: Portals must be placed 7.5 units from each other. Medivh can't place a Portal past its maximum range. Using the Basic Ability to cast the first portal still places the second at Medivh's location. The second portal can be cast at the desired location using either Basic or Active Ability key, but casting with the Active has no cast time. Additionally, the first portal marker remains indefinitely, and Medivh can place the second portal globally so long as it is within the max range of the first indicator.

talents.name: Raven Familiar
talents.description: A Raven Familiar joins allies each time they use a Portal. The Raven will dive at the ally's next Basic Attack against a Hero within 5 seconds, dealing 114 damage and Slowing them by 30% for 2.5 seconds.

fields.notes: Raven Familiar will not be sent by Zul'jin if he has the Talent No Mercy and Basic Attacks a target marked by Grievous Throw. This damage is dealt by the Hero who Basic Attacks, ans therefore subject to their own modifiers on their damage.
